description: Land Title Settlement Department - Sarikkamulla, Panadura D/S Division, Kalutara District - Cad. Map No. 530017 and others
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and encumbrances) in various villages, making it primarily concerned with land and property matters. The content falls under the specialized Land Gazettes category as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and title settlements without any government personnel changes or structural administrative matters.
